meta.description:
A year ago. A year ago i was working on this, on ff 3.0. A year ago, CY4 chose to kick me out of the dev team.

I was not informed

For three weeks.

I was given no real reason at the time.

Today i realised i still had access to the old repo and that i had free will.

Thus here is the prototype for Frozen Farlands 3.0 that i worked on.

Revenge is a dish best served frozen.
